verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents connecting to any MCP server, including existing external ones through a managed proxy, so integrations built outside the vendor can be added to agents. However, the evidence shows no community marketplace, registry, or install flow for community-contributed nodes or components. Organization Skills synced from GitHub are internal rather than community-contributed. Missing for 10: a community node/integration marketplace or registry, a documented install flow for third-party contributed components, and independent corroboration of community-built integrations in use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor

citations.quote: Gumloop supports connecting to any Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. This lets you extend your agents with specialized tools, internal services, or any MCP-compatible API.
Proxied MCPs let you connect existing, external MCP servers to Gumloop through a managed proxy.
